# DataTable

A data table with sorting, selection, pinned and resizable columns, column settings saved on this device,
and virtual scrolling for large data. The columns and props are those of vellum-ui; it is not a wrapper of the
Ant Design table. Place it on a surface, such as a Panel with `flush`.

**Interaction**: sortable headers are buttons: hover and press add the state layer, `Tab` shows the focus ring,
and `Enter` / `Space` sort (none, ascending, descending); the sorted header has `aria-sort`. Checkboxes select
rows (the whole cell is the click area, `Shift`-click selects a range); the header checkbox selects all rows
shown and is mixed when some are selected. The edge of a resizable header can be dragged, or focused with
`Tab` and adjusted with `←` / `→` (16 px, 64 px with `Shift`); `Enter` or a double click restores the default
width. Rows have a state layer on hover; with `onRowClick` the whole row can be clicked, and the main column
should contain a link for the keyboard. Text cut off by `truncate` shows its full text in a tooltip on hover
(after 500 ms) or keyboard focus. While `loading`, the rows stay and the indicator appears after 200 ms.

**Category**: Data · **Common uses**: Lists of records with server-side sorting and pagination, file and asset lists, large logs, tables that
users arrange themselves

## Import

```ts
import { DataTable } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Columns with `compare` can be sorted by clicking their header (or with `Enter` on it); numbers use
`align: 'end'`. Drag the edge of a header, or focus it with `Tab` and press `←` / `→`, to change a column width.
Place the table in a Panel with `flush`.

```tsx
import { Avatar, DataTable, type DataTableColumn, Inline, Panel, Pill, Text } from 'vellum-ui'

interface Project {
  readonly id: string
  readonly name: string
  readonly owner: string
  readonly status: 'active' | 'paused' | 'done'
  readonly files: number
  readonly updated: string
}

const owners = ['Alex Morgan', 'Sam Lee', 'Jordan Park', 'Riley Chen', 'Casey Diaz']

const names = ['Atlas', 'Beacon', 'Cedar', 'Delta', 'Echo', 'Fjord', 'Grove']

const topics = ['brand refresh', 'catalog shoot', 'website launch', 'annual report']

const projects: Project[] = Array.from({ length: 57 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: `p${i + 1}`,
  name: `${names[i % names.length]} ${topics[i % topics.length]}`,
  owner: owners[(i * 3) % owners.length] as string,
  status: (['active', 'paused', 'done'] as const)[i % 3] as Project['status'],
  files: (i * 37) % 420,
  updated: `2026-10-${String((i % 28) + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`,
}))

function StatusPill(props: { readonly status: Project['status'] }) {
  if (props.status === 'active')
    return (
      <Pill tone="success" dot>
        Active
      </Pill>
    )
  if (props.status === 'paused')
    return (
      <Pill tone="warning" dot>
        Paused
      </Pill>
    )
  return <Pill dot>Done</Pill>
}

const projectColumns: DataTableColumn<Project>[] = [
  {
    key: 'name',
    title: 'Project',
    hideable: false,
    truncate: true,
    compare: (a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name),
  },
  {
    key: 'owner',
    title: 'Owner',
    width: 200,
    compare: (a, b) => a.owner.localeCompare(b.owner),
    render: (p) => (
      <Inline gap={2}>
        <Avatar name={p.owner} size={20} />
        <Text size="sm" truncate>
          {p.owner}
        </Text>
      </Inline>
    ),
  },
  { key: 'status', title: 'Status', width: 120, render: (p) => <StatusPill status={p.status} /> },
  {
    key: 'files',
    title: 'Files',
    width: 96,
    align: 'end',
    compare: (a, b) => a.files - b.files,
  },
  {
    key: 'updated',
    title: 'Updated',
    width: 128,
    compare: (a, b) => a.updated.localeCompare(b.updated),
  },
]

export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Panel flush>
      <DataTable
        aria-label="Projects"
        columns={projectColumns}
        rows={projects.slice(0, 6)}
        rowKey={(p) => p.id}
      />
    </Panel>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Selection and bulk actions

`selectable` adds a checkbox to each row; the header checkbox selects every row shown and is mixed when only
some are. `Shift`-click selects a range. Finished projects cannot be selected here (`isRowSelectable`). With
`bulkActions`, the toolbar row turns into a bar with the count, "Clear selection" and the actions while rows are
selected; archiving runs right away and can be undone from the message.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import {
  Avatar,
  Button,
  DataTable,
  type DataTableColumn,
  Icon,
  Inline,
  Input,
  Panel,
  Pill,
  Text,
  useMessage,
} from 'vellum-ui'

interface Project {
  readonly id: string
  readonly name: string
  readonly owner: string
  readonly status: 'active' | 'paused' | 'done'
  readonly files: number
  readonly updated: string
}

const owners = ['Alex Morgan', 'Sam Lee', 'Jordan Park', 'Riley Chen', 'Casey Diaz']

const names = ['Atlas', 'Beacon', 'Cedar', 'Delta', 'Echo', 'Fjord', 'Grove']

const topics = ['brand refresh', 'catalog shoot', 'website launch', 'annual report']

const projects: Project[] = Array.from({ length: 57 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: `p${i + 1}`,
  name: `${names[i % names.length]} ${topics[i % topics.length]}`,
  owner: owners[(i * 3) % owners.length] as string,
  status: (['active', 'paused', 'done'] as const)[i % 3] as Project['status'],
  files: (i * 37) % 420,
  updated: `2026-10-${String((i % 28) + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`,
}))

function StatusPill(props: { readonly status: Project['status'] }) {
  if (props.status === 'active')
    return (
      <Pill tone="success" dot>
        Active
      </Pill>
    )
  if (props.status === 'paused')
    return (
      <Pill tone="warning" dot>
        Paused
      </Pill>
    )
  return <Pill dot>Done</Pill>
}

const projectColumns: DataTableColumn<Project>[] = [
  {
    key: 'name',
    title: 'Project',
    hideable: false,
    truncate: true,
    compare: (a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name),
  },
  {
    key: 'owner',
    title: 'Owner',
    width: 200,
    compare: (a, b) => a.owner.localeCompare(b.owner),
    render: (p) => (
      <Inline gap={2}>
        <Avatar name={p.owner} size={20} />
        <Text size="sm" truncate>
          {p.owner}
        </Text>
      </Inline>
    ),
  },
  { key: 'status', title: 'Status', width: 120, render: (p) => <StatusPill status={p.status} /> },
  {
    key: 'files',
    title: 'Files',
    width: 96,
    align: 'end',
    compare: (a, b) => a.files - b.files,
  },
  {
    key: 'updated',
    title: 'Updated',
    width: 128,
    compare: (a, b) => a.updated.localeCompare(b.updated),
  },
]

export function Selection() {
  const message = useMessage()
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<readonly Project[]>(() => projects.slice(0, 8))
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<readonly string[]>(['p2'])
  const archive = () => {
    const archived = rows.filter((p) => selected.includes(p.id))
    // A reversible action runs right away; the message offers "Undo" instead of asking first
    setRows((list) => list.filter((p) => !selected.includes(p.id)))
    setSelected([])
    message.undoable({
      content:
        archived.length === 1 ? 'Archived 1 project' : `Archived ${archived.length} projects`,
      onUndo: () =>
        setRows((list) =>
          projects.slice(0, 8).filter((p) => list.includes(p) || archived.includes(p)),
        ),
    })
  }
  return (
    <Panel flush>
      <DataTable
        aria-label="Projects"
        columns={projectColumns}
        rows={rows}
        rowKey={(p) => p.id}
        rowLabel={(p) => p.name}
        selectable
        selectedKeys={selected}
        onSelectionChange={setSelected}
        isRowSelectable={(p) => p.status !== 'done'}
        toolbar={<Input.Search aria-label="Search projects" placeholder="Search projects" />}
        bulkActions={
          <Button icon={<Icon name="archive" />} onClick={archive}>
            Archive
          </Button>
        }
      />
    </Panel>
  )
}
```

### Pinned columns

`pin` keeps a column at the start or the end while the others scroll horizontally; a faint line appears where
content passes under it. A typical use is an actions column pinned to the end. Columns without `width` share
the remaining space.

```tsx
import {
  Avatar,
  DataTable,
  type DataTableColumn,
  Inline,
  LinkButton,
  Panel,
  Pill,
  Text,
} from 'vellum-ui'

interface Project {
  readonly id: string
  readonly name: string
  readonly owner: string
  readonly status: 'active' | 'paused' | 'done'
  readonly files: number
  readonly updated: string
}

const owners = ['Alex Morgan', 'Sam Lee', 'Jordan Park', 'Riley Chen', 'Casey Diaz']

const names = ['Atlas', 'Beacon', 'Cedar', 'Delta', 'Echo', 'Fjord', 'Grove']

const topics = ['brand refresh', 'catalog shoot', 'website launch', 'annual report']

const projects: Project[] = Array.from({ length: 57 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: `p${i + 1}`,
  name: `${names[i % names.length]} ${topics[i % topics.length]}`,
  owner: owners[(i * 3) % owners.length] as string,
  status: (['active', 'paused', 'done'] as const)[i % 3] as Project['status'],
  files: (i * 37) % 420,
  updated: `2026-10-${String((i % 28) + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`,
}))

function StatusPill(props: { readonly status: Project['status'] }) {
  if (props.status === 'active')
    return (
      <Pill tone="success" dot>
        Active
      </Pill>
    )
  if (props.status === 'paused')
    return (
      <Pill tone="warning" dot>
        Paused
      </Pill>
    )
  return <Pill dot>Done</Pill>
}

const projectColumns: DataTableColumn<Project>[] = [
  {
    key: 'name',
    title: 'Project',
    hideable: false,
    truncate: true,
    compare: (a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name),
  },
  {
    key: 'owner',
    title: 'Owner',
    width: 200,
    compare: (a, b) => a.owner.localeCompare(b.owner),
    render: (p) => (
      <Inline gap={2}>
        <Avatar name={p.owner} size={20} />
        <Text size="sm" truncate>
          {p.owner}
        </Text>
      </Inline>
    ),
  },
  { key: 'status', title: 'Status', width: 120, render: (p) => <StatusPill status={p.status} /> },
  {
    key: 'files',
    title: 'Files',
    width: 96,
    align: 'end',
    compare: (a, b) => a.files - b.files,
  },
  {
    key: 'updated',
    title: 'Updated',
    width: 128,
    compare: (a, b) => a.updated.localeCompare(b.updated),
  },
]

export function Pinned() {
  const columns: DataTableColumn<Project>[] = [
    { ...(projectColumns[0] as DataTableColumn<Project>), pin: 'start', width: 220 },
    ...projectColumns.slice(1).map((c) => ({ ...c, width: 220 })),
    {
      key: 'actions',
      title: 'Actions',
      width: 112,
      pin: 'end',
      resizable: false,
      render: () => <LinkButton onClick={() => {}}>Open</LinkButton>,
    },
  ]
  return (
    <Panel flush>
      <DataTable
        aria-label="Projects"
        columns={columns}
        rows={projects.slice(0, 5)}
        rowKey={(p) => p.id}
      />
    </Panel>
  )
}
```

## States

### Empty, loading and error

Without rows the default empty state is shown (or `empty`); while the first page loads, the loading indicator
takes its place after 200 ms; `error` with `onRetry` shows the error state with a "Retry" button. The header
stays visible in every state.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import {
  Avatar,
  DataTable,
  type DataTableColumn,
  Inline,
  Panel,
  Pill,
  Segmented,
  Text,
} from 'vellum-ui'

interface Project {
  readonly id: string
  readonly name: string
  readonly owner: string
  readonly status: 'active' | 'paused' | 'done'
  readonly files: number
  readonly updated: string
}

function StatusPill(props: { readonly status: Project['status'] }) {
  if (props.status === 'active')
    return (
      <Pill tone="success" dot>
        Active
      </Pill>
    )
  if (props.status === 'paused')
    return (
      <Pill tone="warning" dot>
        Paused
      </Pill>
    )
  return <Pill dot>Done</Pill>
}

const projectColumns: DataTableColumn<Project>[] = [
  {
    key: 'name',
    title: 'Project',
    hideable: false,
    truncate: true,
    compare: (a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name),
  },
  {
    key: 'owner',
    title: 'Owner',
    width: 200,
    compare: (a, b) => a.owner.localeCompare(b.owner),
    render: (p) => (
      <Inline gap={2}>
        <Avatar name={p.owner} size={20} />
        <Text size="sm" truncate>
          {p.owner}
        </Text>
      </Inline>
    ),
  },
  { key: 'status', title: 'Status', width: 120, render: (p) => <StatusPill status={p.status} /> },
  {
    key: 'files',
    title: 'Files',
    width: 96,
    align: 'end',
    compare: (a, b) => a.files - b.files,
  },
  {
    key: 'updated',
    title: 'Updated',
    width: 128,
    compare: (a, b) => a.updated.localeCompare(b.updated),
  },
]

export function States() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<'empty' | 'loading' | 'error'>('empty')
  return (
    <Panel flush>
      <DataTable
        aria-label="Projects"
        columns={projectColumns}
        rows={[]}
        rowKey={(p) => p.id}
        loading={state === 'loading'}
        error={state === 'error' ? 'The project list could not be loaded.' : undefined}
        onRetry={() => setState('loading')}
        toolbar={
          <Segmented
            value={state}
            onChange={setState}
            options={[
              { label: 'Empty', value: 'empty' },
              { label: 'Loading', value: 'loading' },
              { label: 'Error', value: 'error' },
            ]}
          />
        }
      />
    </Panel>
  )
}
```

## Advanced

### Server-side sorting and pagination

With `sort` and `onSortChange` the server sorts: give the columns `sortable` instead of `compare`. Pagination
goes in `footer` and search in `toolbar`. While a page loads, the current rows stay and the loading indicator
appears only after 200 ms; the main column holds a link, so keyboard users can open a row as well.

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import {
  DataTable,
  type DataTableColumn,
  type DataTableSort,
  Inline,
  Input,
  LinkButton,
  Pagination,
  Panel,
} from 'vellum-ui'

interface Project {
  readonly id: string
  readonly name: string
  readonly owner: string
  readonly status: 'active' | 'paused' | 'done'
  readonly files: number
  readonly updated: string
}

const owners = ['Alex Morgan', 'Sam Lee', 'Jordan Park', 'Riley Chen', 'Casey Diaz']

const names = ['Atlas', 'Beacon', 'Cedar', 'Delta', 'Echo', 'Fjord', 'Grove']

const topics = ['brand refresh', 'catalog shoot', 'website launch', 'annual report']

const projects: Project[] = Array.from({ length: 57 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: `p${i + 1}`,
  name: `${names[i % names.length]} ${topics[i % topics.length]}`,
  owner: owners[(i * 3) % owners.length] as string,
  status: (['active', 'paused', 'done'] as const)[i % 3] as Project['status'],
  files: (i * 37) % 420,
  updated: `2026-10-${String((i % 28) + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`,
}))

function fetchProjects(sort: DataTableSort | null, page: number, size: number) {
  const sorted = [...projects]
  if (sort) {
    const sign = sort.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1
    const key = sort.key as keyof Project
    sorted.sort(
      (a, b) => sign * String(a[key]).localeCompare(String(b[key]), 'en', { numeric: true }),
    )
  }
  return new Promise<{ items: Project[]; total: number }>((resolve) =>
    setTimeout(
      () => resolve({ items: sorted.slice((page - 1) * size, page * size), total: sorted.length }),
      600,
    ),
  )
}

export function ServerSide() {
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<DataTableSort | null>({ key: 'updated', direction: 'desc' })
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1)
  const [data, setData] = useState<{ items: Project[]; total: number } | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true
    setLoading(true)
    fetchProjects(sort, page, 8).then((result) => {
      if (!active) return
      setData(result)
      setLoading(false)
    })
    return () => {
      active = false
    }
  }, [sort, page])
  const columns: DataTableColumn<Project>[] = [
    {
      key: 'name',
      title: 'Project',
      hideable: false,
      truncate: true,
      sortable: true,
      render: (p) => <LinkButton onClick={() => {}}>{p.name}</LinkButton>,
    },
    { key: 'owner', title: 'Owner', width: 180, sortable: true },
    { key: 'files', title: 'Files', width: 96, align: 'end', sortable: true },
    { key: 'updated', title: 'Updated', width: 128, sortable: true },
  ]
  return (
    <Panel flush>
      <DataTable
        aria-label="Projects"
        columns={columns}
        rows={data?.items ?? []}
        rowKey={(p) => p.id}
        sort={sort}
        onSortChange={(next) => {
          setSort(next)
          setPage(1)
        }}
        loading={loading}
        onRowClick={() => {}}
        toolbar={<Input.Search allowClear variant="filled" placeholder="Search projects" />}
        footer={
          <Inline justify="end">
            <Pagination
              size="sm"
              current={page}
              pageSize={8}
              total={data?.total ?? 0}
              onChange={setPage}
            />
          </Inline>
        }
      />
    </Panel>
  )
}
```

### Column settings saved on this device

`columnSettings` adds a button on the right of the toolbar to show and hide columns, change their order, pin
them and restore the defaults. With `storageKey`, these choices and the column widths are kept on this device.
`hideable: false` keeps the main column visible; `defaultHidden` hides a column until users show it.

```tsx
import {
  Avatar,
  DataTable,
  type DataTableColumn,
  Inline,
  Input,
  Panel,
  Pill,
  Text,
} from 'vellum-ui'

interface Project {
  readonly id: string
  readonly name: string
  readonly owner: string
  readonly status: 'active' | 'paused' | 'done'
  readonly files: number
  readonly updated: string
}

const owners = ['Alex Morgan', 'Sam Lee', 'Jordan Park', 'Riley Chen', 'Casey Diaz']

const names = ['Atlas', 'Beacon', 'Cedar', 'Delta', 'Echo', 'Fjord', 'Grove']

const topics = ['brand refresh', 'catalog shoot', 'website launch', 'annual report']

const projects: Project[] = Array.from({ length: 57 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: `p${i + 1}`,
  name: `${names[i % names.length]} ${topics[i % topics.length]}`,
  owner: owners[(i * 3) % owners.length] as string,
  status: (['active', 'paused', 'done'] as const)[i % 3] as Project['status'],
  files: (i * 37) % 420,
  updated: `2026-10-${String((i % 28) + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`,
}))

function StatusPill(props: { readonly status: Project['status'] }) {
  if (props.status === 'active')
    return (
      <Pill tone="success" dot>
        Active
      </Pill>
    )
  if (props.status === 'paused')
    return (
      <Pill tone="warning" dot>
        Paused
      </Pill>
    )
  return <Pill dot>Done</Pill>
}

const projectColumns: DataTableColumn<Project>[] = [
  {
    key: 'name',
    title: 'Project',
    hideable: false,
    truncate: true,
    compare: (a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name),
  },
  {
    key: 'owner',
    title: 'Owner',
    width: 200,
    compare: (a, b) => a.owner.localeCompare(b.owner),
    render: (p) => (
      <Inline gap={2}>
        <Avatar name={p.owner} size={20} />
        <Text size="sm" truncate>
          {p.owner}
        </Text>
      </Inline>
    ),
  },
  { key: 'status', title: 'Status', width: 120, render: (p) => <StatusPill status={p.status} /> },
  {
    key: 'files',
    title: 'Files',
    width: 96,
    align: 'end',
    compare: (a, b) => a.files - b.files,
  },
  {
    key: 'updated',
    title: 'Updated',
    width: 128,
    compare: (a, b) => a.updated.localeCompare(b.updated),
  },
]

export function SavedColumns() {
  const columns: DataTableColumn<Project>[] = [
    ...projectColumns,
    { key: 'id', title: 'ID', width: 96, defaultHidden: true },
  ]
  return (
    <Panel flush>
      <DataTable
        aria-label="Projects"
        columns={columns}
        rows={projects.slice(0, 6)}
        rowKey={(p) => p.id}
        columnSettings
        storageKey="examples.data-table"
        toolbar={<Input.Search allowClear variant="filled" placeholder="Search projects" />}
      />
    </Panel>
  )
}
```

### Large data

With `height` (or `fill`) and more than 100 rows, only the visible rows are rendered: ten thousand rows scroll
smoothly, the header stays at the top and the pinned column stays in place.

```tsx
import { DataTable, Panel } from 'vellum-ui'

const owners = ['Alex Morgan', 'Sam Lee', 'Jordan Park', 'Riley Chen', 'Casey Diaz']

const events = Array.from({ length: 10_000 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: `e${i}`,
  time: `10:${String(Math.floor(i / 60) % 60).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(i % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`,
  user: owners[i % owners.length] as string,
  action: ['Uploaded a file', 'Renamed a folder', 'Shared a link', 'Moved 3 files'][
    i % 4
  ] as string,
  bytes: (i * 7919) % 1_000_000,
}))

export function LargeData() {
  return (
    <Panel flush>
      <DataTable
        aria-label="Activity"
        height={360}
        rows={events}
        rowKey={(e) => e.id}
        selectable
        columns={[
          { key: 'time', title: 'Time', width: 112, pin: 'start' },
          { key: 'user', title: 'User', width: 180 },
          { key: 'action', title: 'Action', truncate: true },
          {
            key: 'bytes',
            title: 'Bytes',
            width: 120,
            align: 'end',
            compare: (a, b) => a.bytes - b.bytes,
          },
        ]}
      />
    </Panel>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-label` | `string` | Accessible name of the table, such as "Projects". | — | Yes |
| `columns` | `readonly DataTableColumn<T>[]` | The columns, in their default order. | — | Yes |
| `rows` | `readonly T[]` | The rows (the current page when paginated). | — | Yes |
| `rowKey` | `(row: T) => string` | Stable key of a row, such as its ID. | — | Yes |
| `sort` | `DataTableSort \| null` | Current sorting (controlled); `null` when not sorted. Use it with `onSortChange`, for example to sort on the server. | — | No |
| `defaultSort` | `DataTableSort \| null` | Initial sorting (uncontrolled). | — | No |
| `onSortChange` | `(sort: DataTableSort \| null) => void` | Called when a sortable header is clicked: none, then ascending, then descending, then none again. | — | No |
| `selectable` | `boolean` | Adds a selection column with a checkbox in each row and a "select all" checkbox in the header. | — | No |
| `selectedKeys` | `readonly string[]` | Keys of the selected rows (controlled); use it with `onSelectionChange`. Keys of rows that are not in `rows` (other pages) are kept. | — | No |
| `defaultSelectedKeys` | `readonly string[]` | Keys of the rows selected at first (uncontrolled). | — | No |
| `onSelectionChange` | `(keys: readonly string[]) => void` | Called with the new keys when the selection changes. | — | No |
| `isRowSelectable` | `(row: T) => boolean` | Whether a row can be selected; rows that cannot have a disabled checkbox and are skipped by "select all". | — | No |
| `rowLabel` | `(row: T) => string` | Name of a row for screen readers, such as its title: the checkbox is read as "Select Alex Morgan". Without it, the content of the first column is used. | — | No |
| `columnSettings` | `boolean` | Shows the column settings button on the right of the toolbar: users can show and hide columns, change their order, pin them, and restore the defaults. | — | No |
| `storageKey` | `string` | Saves the column widths, order, visibility and pinning on this device (in `localStorage` under this key) and restores them on the next visit. Use a key that is unique in your application, such as `'files.table'`. Saved columns that no longer exist are ignored; new columns appear as defined. | — | No |
| `height` | `number` | Height of the table area in pixels (without the toolbar and the footer): the rows scroll inside it and the header stays at the top. | — | No |
| `fill` | `boolean` | Fills the height of the parent (a flex column or an element with a height): the rows scroll inside and the header stays at the top. | — | No |
| `virtual` | `boolean` | Renders only the visible rows. On by default with `height` or `fill` and more than 100 rows; it needs one of them to know the visible area. | — | No |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Loading: the current rows stay, and a loading indicator appears on top of them after 200 ms (fast loads do not flash). Without rows, the indicator takes the place of the empty state. | — | No |
| `error` | `ReactNode` | Error state shown instead of the rows: a text readable by users (never the raw exception), or `true` for the default title only. | — | No |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` | Retry in the error state: when provided, a "Retry" button is shown. | — | No |
| `empty` | `ReactNode` | Shown when there are no rows, instead of the default empty state. | — | No |
| `toolbar` | `ReactNode` | Toolbar on the left above the table: search, filters, actions for the whole table. | — | No |
| `footer` | `ReactNode` | Content below the table, such as Pagination. Leave it out while there are no rows: a pager for an empty list only shows "0" and page 1. | — | No |
| `bulkActions` | `ReactNode` | Actions for the selected rows (usually Buttons). While rows are selected, the toolbar row is replaced in place by a SelectionBar with the number of selected rows, "Clear selection" and these actions; the content below does not move. Needs `selectable`. | — | No |
| `totalCount` | `number` | Number of all rows (all pages), when the table shows one page. Passed to the SelectionBar: it says "All N selected" once everything is selected, and offers "Select all N" before that with `onSelectAll`. When some rows cannot be selected (`isRowSelectable`), pass the number of rows that can. | — | No |
| `onSelectAll` | `() => void` | Selects all rows of all pages (offered by the SelectionBar when `totalCount` is larger than the selection). | — | No |
| `onRowClick` | `(row: T, index: number) => void` | Called when a row is clicked (not when clicking a link, a button, a checkbox or another control in it, or when selecting text). Rows are not focusable: also put a link or a button that does the same thing in the main column, so that keyboard and screen reader users can open the row. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### DataTableColumn<T>

A column of DataTable.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `string` | Stable identifier of the column: used for sorting, for the saved width, order, visibility and pinning, and as the default cell value (`row[key]`). | — | Yes |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | Header content. | — | Yes |
| `label` | `string` | Plain-text name of the column, used in the column settings and by screen readers (resize handle, row checkboxes). Required when `title` is not a string; defaults to `title` when it is one. | — | No |
| `render` | `(row: T, index: number) => ReactNode` | Renders the cell. Without it, the cell shows `row[key]` as text. | — | No |
| `align` | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'` | Horizontal alignment of the header and the cells; use `end` for numbers so that they line up. | `'start'` | No |
| `width` | `number` | Default width in pixels. Columns without a width share the remaining space (at least 120 px each). | — | No |
| `minWidth` | `number` | Smallest width in pixels when resizing. | `56` | No |
| `maxWidth` | `number` | Largest width in pixels when resizing. | `800` | No |
| `pin` | `'start' \| 'end'` | Pins the column to the start or the end: it stays in place while the other columns scroll horizontally. A pinned column without `width` is 160 px wide. Users can change it in the column settings. | — | No |
| `sortable` | `boolean` | The header can be clicked to sort by this column. Rows are sorted locally only when `compare` is given; otherwise sort them yourself (for example on the server) using `onSortChange`. | — | No |
| `compare` | `(a: T, b: T) => number` | Compares two rows for local sorting (ascending order; descending is derived). Implies `sortable`. It sorts the rows passed in `rows` only: when the table shows one page of a longer list, sort the whole list yourself (controlled `sort` and `onSortChange`) before cutting out the page, or sort on the server. | — | No |
| `hideable` | `boolean` | Whether users can hide the column in the column settings. Set `false` for the main column (such as the name), which is always shown. | `true` | No |
| `defaultHidden` | `boolean` | Hidden at first; users can show it in the column settings. | — | No |
| `truncate` | `boolean` | Truncates the cell content to one line with an ellipsis; the full text appears in a tooltip, but only when the text is actually cut off. | — | No |
| `resizable` | `boolean` | Whether the width can be adjusted by dragging the edge of the header or with the keyboard. | `true` | No |

### DataTableSort

The current sorting of a DataTable: which column and in which direction. `null` (in `sort`, `defaultSort` and
`onSortChange`) means not sorted.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `string` | The `key` of the sorted column. | — | Yes |
| `direction` | `'asc' \| 'desc'` | Direction: `asc` ascending, `desc` descending. | — | Yes |
